# rerank_score(query, document, model)

Score a `(query, document)` pair with an **explicit** cross-encoder model (the three-argument arity overload of `rerank_score`).

## Arguments

- `query`, `document` -- the pair to score.
- `model` -- a model name from `supported_models()` (e.g. `Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2`, `BAAI/bge-reranker-base`). Heavier models trade speed for quality and download on first use.

## Returns

`DOUBLE` -- the same relevance logit as the two-argument form.

## Notes

- Scalars are positional; this is an arity overload, not a named arg.
- NULL/empty query or document -> NULL score.

# supported_models()

A discovery table of every cross-encoder reranker the worker can run -- one row per model.

## Result columns

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | VARCHAR | Name to pass as the optional third argument to `rerank_score(query, document, model)`. |
| `license` | VARCHAR | SPDX-style license of the model weights. |

## Notes

Every advertised model is permissive / commercially usable. Calling this function loads no model, so it is always cheap.
